summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of ServiceFlow Phase 1 features: admin login (Vanta.js), admin sidebar, admin users CRUD, ServiceFlow pricing page, client portal login/register, and client dashboard. All 13 specified features tested and passed successfully.

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration warning in browser console: '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>' during loading state. This is caused by the Emergent platform's live edit wrapper injecting a <span> around the <tr> loading row. Non-functional issue but generates console warnings.

integration_issues.issue: Multiple 403 errors for unspecified resources in client dashboard console - likely Meta Pixel or analytics requests being blocked in preview environment. Does not affect core functionality.

issues: When testclient@email.com logs in, dashboard shows 'Compte non lié à un profil client' notice - this is expected since testclient is not linked to a CRM client profile. The yellow warning box is clear and informative.

action_items: No critical action items - all features working as expected
Optional: AdminUsers loading state uses a <tr> that React wraps in <span> due to Emergent platform - minor HTML validity issue that could be addressed
critical_code_review_comments: AdminUsers.jsx: Loading state inside <tbody> may cause HTML validation warning. Consider using a <tr><td colSpan='4'> wrapper for loading state (already done - it IS wrapped, but the platform's live edit adds an extra span wrapper around it).
ClientLogin.jsx: clearClientAuth/setClientAuth/getClientToken are exported from the page component file - consider moving to a separate utils/auth file for better separation of concerns.
ClientDashboard.jsx imports from './ClientLogin' - circular dependency risk if ClientLogin ever imports from ClientDashboard.
AdminUsers.jsx: The useSearchParams import is declared but never used - minor dead code.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test users during testing (testuser_playwright@test.com, testclient_play_*@test.com) - both deleted after testing. testclient@email.com was pre-existing and untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase 1 features fully tested and working. Admin login at /admin/login uses Vanta.js NET animation (violet/gold background). Admin sidebar has ServiceFlow logo, CMGeorges Workspace badge, and Paramètres section with Utilisateurs/Blog/CodesPromo/Tarification/Politiques links. AdminUsers CRUD (create/toggle active/reset password/delete) all working. ServiceFlow pricing at /serviceflow/pricing shows 3 plans with correct prices (Starter 29$, Pro 79$, Business 149$) - Pro plan has 'Recommandé' badge. Client portal at /client/login has Vanta animation and login/register tabs. testclient@email.com / password123 login works and redirects to client dashboard with Tableau de bord/Mes projets/Mes factures tabs. Client is NOT linked to a CRM client profile so shows 0 stats - this is expected.
